name: Header 20
definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

MessageFunction.name: Message Function
MessageFunction.definition: Identifies the type of process related to the message.

ProtocolVersion.name: Protocol Version
ProtocolVersion.definition: Version of the ATM protocol specifications.

ExchangeIdentification.name: Exchange Identification
ExchangeIdentification.definition: Unique identification of an exchange occurrence.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was created.

InitiatingParty.name: Initiating Party
InitiatingParty.definition: Unique identification of the partner that has initiated the exchange.

RecipientParty.name: Recipient Party
RecipientParty.definition: Unique identification of the partner that is the recipient of the message exchange.

ProcessState.name: Process State
ProcessState.definition: State of the sender of the message inside the process flow.

Traceability.name: Traceability
Traceability.definition: Identification of partners involved in exchange from the merchant to the issuer, with the relative timestamp of their exchanges.
